- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment phases (high sentiment > 0.7) — reduce forecast peak by 5–10%.
- Underestimate prices during low sentiment (sentiment < 0.3) — add 3–5% to forecast to compensate for mean reversion bias.
- Overshoot after sharp upward spikes — cap forecast at 10–15% below the immediate prior peak.
- Lagged price movements: if sentiment rises sharply, delay forecast peak by 1–2 days; if sentiment drops, anticipate early correction.
- Mean reversion bias: if 3–5 consecutive days show downward trend, reduce forecast slope by 10–15%.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts tend to overestimate late-period prices — adjust final 5–7 days downward by 2–4% if sentiment is neutral or declining.
